messages:
leah: Brainstorm: rather than just static charts, what if the landing page hero is an interactive micro-explorer that surfaces latency vs cost tradeoffs by workload? Aim: let buyers find their point in <30s.

omar: Love that. Could be a tiny dropdown: workload (chat/search/embed), infra (hosted/dedicated/private), scale slider -> updates scatter + callout.

viv: We need two canonical static images for the webinar and socials though: 1) simplified scatter with three annotated use-case pins, 2) compact bar showing $/1k tokens across deploy types for a sample workload. Keep wording generic (Model X/Y/Z).

charlie: Data note: eng please confirm whether we publish medians with P95 in tooltip or P50/P95 lines on chart. bench-bot: export queued -> /eng-ml/benchmarks/212345/interactive_export.csv

mavis: Messaging test: Variant A headline = "Where should you run inference? See the tradeoffs." Variant B = "Pick latency or cost. We show both." We'll A/B hero on the landing page.

leah: Routing: clicks on explorer -> micro-form (company size, infra interest, tokens/day). Map: infra=private -> AE outreach; tokens>1B -> SDR. Keep form 3 fields to avoid friction.

omar: Conversion tracking: tag which workload filter user used; that helps route to correct PM/AE. Also capture "interested in demo" boolean.

viv: Accessibility: colorblind palette + shapes, big tap targets for mobile. Also short alt text that summarizes the hero in one sentence.

charlie: Design asks: provide the static chart rules (axis labels, tick formatting, color palette, annotation style) so design can create two hero variants quickly. Also a tiny methodology footnote: default batch=8, hardware=NVIDIA-A100.

mavis: For socials: short hooks, with two CTAs to test: "Register" vs "Try interactive". Track cost-per-lead separately.

leah: Demo plan for webinar: 1 slide problem, 1 static scatter, quick live filter on explorer, then a short customer vignette showing routing & cost delta. End with CTA to book capacity consult.

omar: Legal/compliance: confirm we can show ranges and not exact per-model public numbers. We'll keep hero ranges and put exact numbers in appendix + methodology doc. bench-bot: methodology note attached -> /eng-ml/benchmarks/212345/method.md

viv: Action items: charlie -> chart spec doc (axes, sample numbers, tooltip fields); omar -> interactive spec + data contract with eng; mavis -> social hooks + A/B plan; leah -> landing copy + micro-form.

charlie: I'll mock specs today, using three sample apps: low-throughput chat, medium search, high-throughput embedding.

omar: Eng ping: please surface CSV to #eng-ml and flag if any numbers are provisional.

bench-bot: export ready -> /eng-ml/benchmarks/212345/interactive_export.csv (medians across 10 runs, default batch=8).

leah: Timeline: CSV now, design mocks by tomorrow noon, landing + form Thursday AM, rehearsal Friday.

mavis: We'll run the two headline variants for 48h on socials, measure CTR -> interactive vs register conversion.

viv: One more: keep main hero model labels abstract (Model A/B/C), but add a small "why this matters" subtitle explaining routing advantages and cost levers (batching, quantization, dedicated pools).

leah: Perfect. If anyone has competitor examples of interactive tradeoff tools, drop links here. I'll assemble a one-pager and tag folks for review. :sparkles:
